_note: Hand corrections to score.py's verdicts, keyed reader/certificate.attempt/field, each with its reason. After the run of 20 Nov 2026 every entry the script did not mark right (20 empty, 56 wrong) was read beside the certificate and the key: all 76 verdicts stand, so there is no correction. The 56 wrong entries are each a number printed on the certificate: in another method's field (four-acid copper as aqua regia or cyanide-soluble; acid-soluble as cyanide-soluble), in the wrong unit (ppm in a % field, ppb in a ppm field), the wrong statistic (2SD, an expanded uncertainty or its half, the lower end of a 95 % confidence or uncertainty interval as the 1SD), or an indicative or uncertified value filed as certified.
